source: assets/Corp Deck 2025 - Nov.pptx slide 3 ('An AI-Powered Software Engineering Disruptor'). The original packs 8 stats into a 4×2 grid with vertical line connectors between columns ('11,000+ / 400 / 4 / 36% / 40+ / 13 / 10 / 500+'). This example collapses to 6 stats — the kpi_grid archetype caps at 6 — by selecting the most brand-relevant scale measures (Ascenders / Clients / AI Studios / Fortune-500 share / Countries / Global Delivery Hubs).
designer: Ascendion Corp Deck Nov 2025 brand team
intent: Stat-heavy 'scale of company' or 'reach of program' slide where the audience should remember the magnitudes. Uses a quieter monochromatic treatment with line dividers (vs. the per-cell accent bars in capability_snapshot) so the numbers are the loudest visual element. Preferred when the deck style is monochrome_plus_one and the numbers carry the message.
invariants: header bar with kicker + title above the grid
exactly 6 stat tiles in a 2-row × 3-column grid
each tile: display-size numeric value (accent_1, bold) + body-style label below
vertical line dividers spanning both rows between columns (drawn once, not per cell)
horizontal divider between the two rows (subtle accent_6)
no images, no per-cell fills, no accent bars per cell
variables: stat labels (3-7 words, noun-led, sentence case)
title (claim-style; can be longer than capability_snapshot title since this slide is monochromatic)
